summary: rwc-client preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The npm package rwc-client 0.29.12 declares a `preinstall` lifecycle hook that runs `setup.mjs`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line Bun-compiled blob (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) obfuscated with a shuffled string-array cipher (WV8StW rotator over a mixed-literal array) and hex-named globals. The package's advertised purpose is a Vue chat UI library; neither Bun nor math_init.js is mentioned in the README. Alien-runtime download + install-time execution of opaque, obfuscated bytes bypasses Node-based review of what the package actually runs on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
